title: The four tiers
desc: Each change gets a tier from the files it touches. Tier 1, a small fix, needs locked tests. Tier 2, a normal change, adds a plan and a review. Tollgate merges tiers 1 and 2 itself. Tier 3, login, payments, or user data, and tier 4, production or the locks themselves, add an AI review on GitHub, and you merge them.

nodes.text:
A small fix
Locked tests.
Tollgate merges it.

A normal change
+ a plan and a review.
Tollgate merges it.

Login, payments, data
+ an AI review on GitHub.
You merge it.

Production, the locks
+ an AI review on GitHub.
You merge it.
